observation.command: TOK=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && CID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && UID1=acf1a53a-9e6e-4c76-a983-2dac22d10526 && FULL=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CID/roles" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK") && echo "$FULL" | jq -c '.[]' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$FULL" -w "assign all: HTTP:%{http_code}\n" && echo "=== verify ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID1/role-mappings/clients/$CID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[].name'
